proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro Ω ι _ _ _ I A
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have e : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => ∀ i ∈ I, ω ∉ A i)) = (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => ¬ ∃ i ∈ I, ω ∈ A i)) := by
    ext ω; simp
  have hc : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => ∃ i ∈ I, ω ∈ A i)).card : ℝ) + (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => ¬ ∃ i ∈ I, ω ∈ A i)).card = Fintype.card Ω := by
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Finset.univ) (fun ω => ∃ i ∈ I, ω ∈ A i)
  rw [e]
  field_simp
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (I : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset Ω), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => ∃ i ∈ I, ω ∈ A i)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = 1 - ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => ∀ i ∈ I, ω ∉ A i)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω
